benchmark_method.ten: One daytime project June 21, 4 drones/10 Krots/80 containers/13 carriers, side256m cell0.5m, begins at t=100s; all ten digging at start; different load from coastal control

limitations: Container timing variance is substantial; no speedup claim
Offscreen CPU/event timings are not desktop Windows FPS
Capital estimate values currently owned equipment and cumulative gross excavation, not cash/OPEX ledger
One batch courier and serialized side dock/lift limit throughput
New files version21; reads1..20 without adding robots or prices
Krot bodies are chosen before placement, not hot added to a working base
